summary: IHS Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, attaching a press release announcing Q1 2026 financial results. The release states that in February 2026, the company announced a proposed sale to MTN Group Ltd at an enterprise value of $6.2 billion. It also disclosed agreements to sell a 51% stake in I-Systems to TIM S.A. and its Latin American tower operations to Macquarie Asset Management at an enterprise value of ~$952 million. These operations are classified as discontinued operations. The filing does not include specific price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisers. The pending sale to MTN constitutes a strategic review event. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder vote.
